description: Αποχετευση Ακαθαρτων Οριστικη Μελετη is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Δήμος Ραφήνας – Πικερμίου. Coverage: Δήμος Ραφήνας – Πικερμίου. The portal shows the English title as "Szennyvízszennyeződések végső tanulmánya" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Δήμος Ραφήνας – Πικερμίου. Its keywords include Από μετάπτωση, repository.data.gov.gr, Αποχετευση. The listing shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
